sample_size_basis: fixed budget; ten old seeds only support rough precision planning, not assured power
stop_rule: complete fixed batch; only engineering failures stop queue; no outcome-dependent seed additions
basins: all 107 frozen test basins, observed flow available for historical selection only
selection_rule: choose M1 iff earlier-period NSE(M1)-NSE(B0)>0; ties choose B0
primary_endpoint: D: mean chosen-minus-fixed-B0 NSE with same weights minus mean with different training instance
aggregation: equal basins; equal source seeds; equal different target seeds, excluding identity diagonal
uncertainty: 5000 joint whole-seed and HUC2 multinomial resamples; same-seed weights linear; off-diagonal original identity pair weights product, exclude original identity matches; percentile 95% intervals; approximate with ten seeds
primary_inference: single prespecified endpoint D, positive direction; report effect and CI regardless of sign
practical_reference_interpretation: operational scale chosen before new outcomes, not a universal usefulness threshold; lower95>0 and point>=0.01 supports positive material attenuation, lower95>0.01 supports attenuation above this scale
deployment_claim_requirement: also report same/other gains vs each fixed model; if same-weight gain is not positive, do not claim beneficial selection; if other-weight gain stays positive, do not claim disappearance
supporting_analysis: cross-period same/different seed rank/sign agreement; mean and median structure effects; per-basin distributions; leave-one-seed and leave-one-HUC sensitivity
flow_analysis: all/low/mid/high MAE secondary exploratory; report all, no promotion to primary after seeing results
missing_policy: fail on incomplete roster, changed observation masks or nonfinite predictions; log and resolve engineering causes without selecting basins or seeds by performance
boundary: new training instances on old split and periods; not independent spatial or new-data validation; not a strictly ungauged selection policy
test_scoring: separate after batch completion and artifact verification
EA_LSTM: later conditional scope extension; not in this launch
old_results: exploratory, displayed separately; do not pool into the primary confirmation estimate
